content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria locked out by Stripe's restrictions. Every attempt to onboard Stripe fails. Every payout delay on Gumroad weighs on your business. NowPayments offers a way out, but you need a clear infrastructure guide to deploy your digital store. In this guide, we'll walk you through every step to set up a NOWPayments digital store that accepts crypto payments for your digital products and delivers them instantly. We'll cover the infrastructure you need, the payment and delivery pipeline, and how to scale once you're live. By the end of this guide, you'll have a working digital store and a clear understanding of why this infrastructure works when platforms fail.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments doesn't rely on platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad that often fail or restrict creators in your region. It connects directly to the blockchain, ensuring automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and instant delivery to your customers. With NOWPayments, you have full control over your payment and delivery pipeline, and you can scale without relying on third-party infrastructure. This infrastructure is built to last, not to rent, and is pressure-tested against actual payment rejection and financial isolation.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosted website, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend, a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store orders, and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 storage bucket for file delivery. You'll also need to install the NOWPayments plugin and configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Don't worry if this sounds daunting; we'll break it down into manageable steps in the following sections.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your website and configure the payment and delivery workflow. This involves installing the NOWPayments plugin, setting up your payment and delivery settings, and configuring your webhook to receive payment notifications. With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and deliver your digital products instantly to your customers. You can also configure your payment and delivery pipeline to work with your existing workflow.
NOWPayments' 0.5% fee structure makes it one of the most cost-effective payment gateways for digital creators.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. With NOWPayments, you can test your payment and delivery workflow before going live, ensuring that everything is working as expected. When you're ready, you can start processing transactions and delivering your digital products to your customers. Remember to monitor your payments and delivery performance to ensure that everything is working smoothly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your NOWPayments digital store is live and processing transactions, it's time to scale your infrastructure to meet growing demand. With NOWPayments, you can easily scale your payment and delivery pipeline by adding more storage, increasing your compute resources, or configuring your payment and delivery settings to work with your existing workflow. We'll cover best practices for scaling your NOWPayments digital store in the following sections.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable, and local exchanges exist in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela with competitive rates. The conversion to naira, cedis, shillings, rupees, or bolívares takes 20-30 minutes on average. This is the complete path from digital product sale to local currency: NOWPayments verifies on-chain, webhook triggers delivery, USDT lands in your wallet, P2P converts to local currency.
With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and deliver your digital products instantly to your customers.
